title: HermesTV Watch Intelligence Record
description: Per-profile watch state and derived intelligence for a single catalog item. Powers resume, recommendations, and 'More with this actor' UI. Chrome 76 compatible.

item_id.description: Catalog item ID (matches catalog item 'id' field).

profile_id.description: Profile this watch record belongs to.

watched_pct.description: Percentage of the item watched (0–100). Used to drive 'Continue Watching' rail threshold.

last_watched_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent watch session for this item.

resume_position_sec.description: Playback position in seconds for resume. 0 if not started or if watched to completion.

times_watched.description: Total number of complete or near-complete views.

provider_preference.description: Provider preferred by this profile for this item, if the user has explicitly chosen one.

similar_item_ids.description: Catalog item IDs recommended as similar content (pre-computed, served from backend).

more_with_actor_ids.description: Actor IDs for 'More with this actor' recommendations derived from cast of this item.
